title: Floor Area Regulations in Subdistrict D
previewText: For zoning lots that are located partially in a Commercial District mapped within an R8A District and partially in a Commercial District mapped within an R9A District, residential floor area may transfer across the zoning district boundary from the Commercial District mapped within an R8A District to the Commercial District mapped within an R9A District.
